use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

let blocks = [
    ["...", "...", "..."],
    [".#.", "###", "..."],
    [".#.", ".##", ".#."],
    ["...", "###", ".#."],
    [".#.", "##.", ".#."]
]

let grid = 8
let tile = grid * 2 + 1

let random = System.Random(3)

column_of(block: int, column: int) -> string =>
    blocks[block] |> map(row => "{row[column]}") |> join("")

fits_right(left: int, right: int) -> bool =>
    column_of(left, 2) =~ column_of(right, 0)

fits_below(top: int, bottom: int) -> bool =>
    blocks[top][2] =~ blocks[bottom][0]

wrap(i: int) -> int => (i + grid) % grid

attempt() -> List[int]? is
    let placed = repeat(-1, grid * grid) |> collect_list()
    let options =
        LIST[LIST[int]](
            (0..grid * grid) |> map(_ => LIST[int](0..blocks.count)))

    for _ in 0..grid * grid do
        let open =
            (0..grid * grid) |> filter(i => placed[i] < 0) |> collect_list()

        let least =
            open |> map(i => options[i].count) |> reduce(99, int.min)

        if least == 0 then
            return null
        fi

        let candidates =
            open |> filter(i => options[i].count == least) |> collect_list()

        let cell = candidates[random.next(candidates.count)]
        let choice = options[cell][random.next(options[cell].count)]
        let row = cell / grid, column = cell % grid

        placed[cell] = choice

        let right = row * grid + wrap(column + 1)
        let left = row * grid + wrap(column - 1)
        let below = wrap(row + 1) * grid + column
        let above = wrap(row - 1) * grid + column

        options[right].remove_all(b => !fits_right(choice, b))
        options[left].remove_all(b => !fits_right(b, choice))
        options[below].remove_all(b => !fits_below(choice, b))
        options[above].remove_all(b => !fits_below(b, choice))
    od

    placed
si

let tries mut = 1
let placed mut = attempt()

while !placed? do
    tries = tries + 1
    placed = attempt()
od

let blocks_placed = placed!

pixel(y: int, x: int) -> char =>
    let row = Math.min(y / 2, grid - 1) in
    let column = Math.min(x / 2, grid - 1) in
    blocks[blocks_placed[row * grid + column]][y - 2 * row][x - 2 * column]


write_line("collapsed on attempt {tries}")
write_line("")

for y in 0..tile do
    write_line((0..tile) |> map(x => "{pixel(y, x)}") |> join(""))
od

let scale = 12
let image = IMAGE(tile * scale, tile * scale)

image.clear(250ub, 250ub, 245ub)
image.colour(30ub, 40ub, 60ub)

for y in 0..tile do
    for x in 0..tile do
        if pixel(y, x) == '#' then
            image.fill_rectangle(
                cast double(x * scale), cast double(y * scale),
                cast double((x + 1) * scale), cast double((y + 1) * scale))
        fi
    od
od

image.write("tile.png")

image.show("tile.png")
